verdict.rationale: n8n has a public API (the docs page title "n8n API" is listed), but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI and Swagger path on the docs domain returning 404. An API spec is a fair question for a workflow platform with a public API, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence means "none", not "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
